text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City achieved a splendid result
in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Impressively low blood pressure again today, huh!
Impressively low blood pressure again today, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You're amazingly loud
for this early in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Should we push back the start time a bit?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Because I wanna run as much as possible, even if it's just a little more."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I gotta take you up
to even greater heights, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I think I'm starting to wake up now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...You're thinking I'm acting like a brat, aren't you?
choice_data_list: I really think you just love running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, warm-up first.
Well, I'm off then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City began to run.
Bathed in the sunlight, she ran with sheer joy,
today as well—
